# Project: Micro-ERP / MES (single Algerian factory)

## Stack
- Next.js 14+ (App Router). All mutations = Server Actions in `app/actions/*`.
- TypeScript strict. No `any`.
- Drizzle ORM + PostgreSQL. Redis + BullMQ for background jobs. Docker on-premise.
- Auth: NextAuth v5 (Auth.js), Credentials provider, JWT sessions, bcrypt hashing.

## Hard rules (never violate)
- Every mutation is a Server Action ("use server") that validates input with Zod.
- Never write raw SQL EXCEPT the invoice gapless-counter update.
- Money & currency: DZD only. No tax logic (no TVA/TAP/stamp duty).
- UI is English only. No i18n framework, no RTL, layout is always LTR.
- Single factory, single instance. `facilityId` columns exist but are constant.
- No OAuth/external identity providers (server may be offline). Credentials only.

## Non-negotiable domain logic (do NOT "simplify" these)
- Invoice numbers are GAPLESS per (facility, fiscal year), generated by an atomic
  `UPDATE ... RETURNING` on a single counter row inside a transaction.
- Inventory quantity lives on LOTS, never on items.
- Lot genealogy links input lots -> output lots for recall traceability.
- Stock picking uses FEFO (First-Expired-First-Out): ORDER BY expires_at ASC.
- Protected routes require an authenticated session; check role for mutations.

## Conventions
- DB schema files: `db/schema/*.ts`. snake_case in DB, camelCase in TS.
- Server Actions return a typed result object, never throw raw errors to client.
- Tests: Vitest, colocated as `*.test.ts`.
